title: Analysis of the Ethiopic Twitter Dataset for Abusive Speech in Amharic
findings: The study's definition of hate speech, based on an Ethiopian draft law, includes targeting individuals or groups based on religion. The analysis of hate speech keywords in the Amharic Twitter dataset found 'ኢስላም/Islam' among the terms used. The paper also mentions separating tweets in the Ge'ez language, which is primarily used for religious texts by the Ethiopian Orthodox Church.
